en.title: Shape masks that move or grow keep their image; the limits of effects said
en.body: From the notes of Mechanism City. A shape mask (`node.mask = sprite`) was drawn again on the CPU whenever it moved or was scaled, which made a circle growing to the whole screen cost seconds a frame under software rendering. Now a mask that only moves keeps its image, placed where it is, and one that grows or shrinks evenly keeps it, stretched, until it has changed by an eighth of an octave; a growing mask is drawn again some 8 times for each doubling instead of every frame. The page on effects says what a mask costs, and that a ninth effect group in one frame makes the Host refuse that frame, whose error now says "more than 8 effect groups in one frame" (or that effects are off, or nested more than 4 deep).

zh.title: 移动或放大的形状遮罩沿用原图；写明效果的上限
zh.body: 来自《千机巧匠》的笔记。形状遮罩（`node.mask = sprite`）过去只要移动或缩放就在 CPU 上重画，一个放大到全屏的圆形遮罩在软件渲染下单帧要好几秒。现在只移动的遮罩沿用原图并放到新位置，均匀缩放的遮罩沿用原图并拉伸，直到变化超过八分之一个倍频才重画；放大中的遮罩每放大一倍约重画 8 次，而不是每帧都画。效果文档写明了遮罩的代价，以及一帧里出现第 9 个效果组时 Host 会拒绝这一帧，错误信息现在写明 "more than 8 effect groups in one frame"（或效果未开启、嵌套超过 4 层）。
